look_here_first: Start with the fruit arrangement and opposite leaves. American beautyberry has tight rings/clusters of vivid purple-magenta berries hugging the stem at the leaf axils, plus opposite serrate leaves on a softly hairy shrub.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: small pale pinkish flowers in axillary cymes

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: dense beadlike purple-magenta fruit clusters encircling the stem at nodes

lookalikes.differences: Opposite serrate leaves + dense purple berry rings directly at the nodes are the fastest confirmation.
